'''Enid Vahr''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent embedded with [[Vortex Corporation]] to discover any military contracts or technology affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was very successful in this endeavor. Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Demophon supernova]] he was transferred to the [[Demophon]] branch of Vortex. A few weeks before the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] he made contact with rebels on [[Asteroid Base]] and claimed to have data on a new long-range [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]]. He then vanished. Rebel agents later discovered that he had paid [[Jor Entel]] to evacuate him from the planet, and was murdered as part of Entel's moneymaking scheme.<ref name="BE" />
